definitions.explanation: The tub portion of a Japanese bath that holds hot water for soaking. In Japanese bathing culture, one washes and rinses outside the tub before entering the bathtub to soak.

examples.japanese: {湯船|ゆぶね}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{浸|つ}かる→浸かる：13290_tsukaru⟧。
{湯船|ゆぶね}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦お{湯|ゆ}→お湯：02518_oyu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{熱|あつ}すぎた。
examples.english: The water in the bathtub was too hot.

examples.japanese: ⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{洗|あら}って→洗う：00827_arau⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{湯船|ゆぶね}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{習慣|しゅうかん}→習慣：01429_shuukan⟧だ。
examples.english: It's a Japanese custom to wash your body before getting into the bathtub.

notes:
USAGE:
The standard everyday word for a bathtub in Japanese. In Japanese homes, the {湯船|ゆぶね} is strictly for soaking, not for washing — one rinses off at a separate washing area before entering. The word literally means "hot water vessel" (from ⟦{湯|ゆ}→湯：01740_yu⟧ + ⟦{船|ふね}→船：00775_fune⟧).

Also called ⟦{浴槽|よくそう}→浴槽：04985_yokusou⟧, which is more formal/technical.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {湯船|ゆぶね}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{浸|つ}かる→浸かる：13290_tsukaru⟧: to soak in the bathtub
- {湯船|ゆぶね}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧: to get into the bathtub
- {湯船|ゆぶね}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧: to get out of the bathtub
- {湯船|ゆぶね}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦お{湯|ゆ}→お湯：02518_oyu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{張|は}る→張る：12583_haru⟧: to fill the bathtub with hot water
